methods.summary: Close a session and remove everything it created

methods.summary: The Slack fixture: the agent's app, the workspace, and where the agent reaches the fake

methods.summary: Create a person

methods.name: capabilities
methods.summary: Per action: works in the fake, works live, and what live needs

methods.name: say
methods.summary: Post a message in a room as this person

methods.name: messages
methods.summary: The room's messages, oldest first, with a cursor for the next read

methods.summary: Create a person in the workspace

methods.summary: Create a channel. Only the listed participants are members; include the app for it to receive events

methods.name: deliveries
methods.summary: Every event channelstack sent the agent for this session, with every attempt

methods.name: calls
methods.summary: The Web API calls the agent made about this session's conversations

methods.name: uninstallApp
methods.summary: The workspace uninstalls the app. Undone when this session closes; run such tests on their own

methods.summary: Inject a transport fault into the agent's Web API calls. Removed when this session closes

waits.name: waitForCall
waits.what: an API call from the agent

methods.summary: Delete a message: this person's own, or anyone's for an admin

methods.summary: Add an emoji reaction to a message

methods.name: unreact
methods.summary: Remove this person's emoji reaction from a message

methods.name: openDM
methods.summary: Open (or reuse) a DM with the app, another person, or several

methods.name: invite
methods.summary: Invite people or the app to a channel

methods.name: kick

methods.name: ephemeral
methods.summary: Messages only this person can see

methods.summary: Top-level messages of a conversation, oldest first

methods.name: members

methods.summary: The conversation as a person would read it, threads included

methods.summary: Re-read a message: its latest text, edits and deliveries

methods.name: reactions

methods.name: state
methods.summary: What the agent is doing in a thread: its status line, an open stream, or idle

methods.name: transcript
methods.summary: A thread as a person would read it

methods.name: refresh
methods.summary: Re-read a delivery: its attempts and status

methods.summary: Retry the way Slack does: the same payload, with X-Slack-Retry-Num and X-Slack-Retry-Reason
